definitions.explanation: Physical power or effort provided by people rather than machines. Refers to tasks accomplished through human effort alone.

examples.japanese: {人力|じんりき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{運|はこ}んだ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全|すべ}て→全て：03822_subete⟧{人力|じんりき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たよ}っていた→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧。
examples.english: In the era before machines, everything relied on human power.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{人力|じんりき}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{動|うご}かす→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不可能|ふかのう}→不可能：03144_fukanou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧。
examples.english: Moving this large stone by human power alone is nearly impossible.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧ (person) + {力|りき} (power). Often contrasted with ⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧ (machine power).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人力|じんりき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (by manpower, manually)
- {人力|じんりき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たよ}る→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧ (to rely on human power)
- {人力|じんりき}{車|しゃ} (rickshaw — literally "human-powered vehicle")
- {人力|じんりき}⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧ (human-powered aircraft)

USAGE:
{人力|じんりき}{車|しゃ} (rickshaw) is a well-known compound. In modern usage, {人力|じんりき} often appears when emphasizing that something is done without mechanical assistance. The word ⟦{人手|ひとで}→人手：25438_hitode⟧ is more common in everyday language when talking about labor or manpower in a workforce sense.
